scope: Read only S039 fixed A20 TRAIN and VAL saved rows; no head/cache/image load, model inference, server or GPU. TEST/Unknown-02 are not opened by review.
representation: Keep A20 2800params fixed-B read, old B-P3 ROI, W=min(S_A,S_Q) and frozen M input; no Q-aligned visual read, new feature/loss head, support change or artificial proposal.
labels: GT canonical long/short mapped by frozen M raw and model-B axis identity. No GT projection and no GT-dependent inference.
errors: z_j=log(pre_guard_pred_j/GT_j); E_j=abs(expm1(z_j)), same single-edge absolute relative error as reporting. Fixed M/A20 references use delivered boxes. Pre-guard invalid or overflow stops; no clipping/filtering. Final delivered protection reported separately.

fixed_masks.reference: M on near-only; A20 on gain-only; min(E_M,E_A20) on overlap; inactive entries zero in mean2N
fixed_masks.frozen: Computed only once on complete TRAIN for training. VAL masks only for evaluation, never fed into fit or inference. GT/reference tensors detached. No subset sampler or active-count normalization.

losses.L0: Original A20 mean2N SmoothL1_beta0.1(delta_roi-target_roi), reusing original graph
losses.Lratio: meanN SmoothL1_beta0.1(z_long-z_short), exactly old A048 ratio form
losses.limits: Soft, reactive, training-only objective; no hard no-regression, first-step or shared-parameter guarantee. No new inference evidence and no novelty claim from ratio supervision. Fixed coefficients are engineering draft choices, not optimized or empirically justified.

continuation_design_not_launched.start: All from same fixed A20 head weights; reset Adam moments and RNG by identical rule; do NOT zero the trained terminal or reuse engineering weights
continuation_design_not_launched.order_proposed: same sorted(scale,image) 5112 output views, shuffle Random(1703+20+continuation_epoch), no GT sampling
continuation_design_not_launched.missing: all 5116 views accounted, four missing outputs remain missing; all 5112 outputs supervised including two historical fallback views
continuation_design_not_launched.validation: epoch0 replay identity only, then full887 VAL at each of six epochs in every arm. No TRAIN admission, no TEST/depth for choice.
continuation_design_not_launched.engineering_before_future_fit: Actual cache + A20 replay, pre/final fallback identity, zero-coefficient C loss/grad/Adam equivalence, frozen refs, axis mapping, exact checkpoint/RNG restore, resource measurement. Synthetic proof here does not complete these checks.

evaluation_draft.direct: Domain long/shortMAE, P95,bias,a/r; fixed M near and A20 useful-gain groups by edge, no net-count-only success
evaluation_draft.benefit_retention: sum min(max(E_M-E_new,0),E_M-E_A20) over fixed gain edges / sum(E_M-E_A20), separately domain/edge and scale. Also counts still beneficial, lost, reversed and gained; per-edge capping prevents extra gains elsewhere hiding loss.
evaluation_draft.hard_inherited: All arms use original S038 M-relative eligibility/identity/DFR/MCML/TDR/ACI gates; retain documented 0.1pp domain and near MAE cost allowances, no TEST-driven relaxation.
evaluation_draft.additional_common_adoption_draft: Apply to C/R/P uniformly: VAL Sim bothMAE <= fixedA20+1e-6 and at least one <A20-1e-6; Sim meanabs(r)<A20-1e-6 and meanabs(a)<=A20+1e-6; Real edgeMAEs<=A20+0.001. Overall fullRIoU>=A20-1e-5. No automatic promotion.
evaluation_draft.mechanism_vs_R_and_C: At representatives chosen by same rule, P must reduce protected excess-error loss vs R by >1e-6 in each domain, not lose fixed A20 useful-gain retention vs R beyond 1e-6, and keep Sim eachMAE <= R+1e-6 and <= C+1e-6. Separate local usefulness from full adoption.
evaluation_draft.selection: Same eligibility then lexicographic Sim longMAE, Sim shortMAE, Real longMAE, Real shortMAE, earlier continuation_epoch. None eligible: same-key descriptive representative only. No custom weighted composite score.
evaluation_draft.reporting: Full original custom mean_RIoU,DFR,ACI,MCML,TDR,AP50/75 supplement; center<15px/output,sizeboth<=10%/output,angle180period<=3deg/GTaspect>=1.2 output; coverage/missing/full-frame correct coverage; overall/domain/video. Protect and harmful-direction statistics do not replace final metrics.
evaluation_draft.depth: No depth data is read or used here. Future frozen Raw-opt evaluation needs separately fixed development/independent-data roles; Unknown-02 cannot select candidates or epochs.

history.S021: Static complete-TRAIN domain/scale/edge residual-group weights (near=1,cap4,mean-one), NOT dynamic weighting. New hinge activation depends on new error exceeding fixed per-edge reference, while memberships/reference stay fixed.
history.A048: Explicit GT ratio loss already tried. R is required ablation on new fixed A20 start, not a novel ratio mechanism.
history.L20: Local per-position size supervision constrains hidden local predictions. P only constrains final canonical edge error against frozen baselines; shared-parameter interference may still lose useful corrections.
history.seven_slot: No artificial proposals or changes in input organization.
history.native_P3_or_Q_alignment: No change of feature source, coordinates, network or decode.
history.distillation: Error ceiling supervised by GT, not A20 coordinate matching; predictions better than A20 are unpenalized.

stop: This turn stops after full saved-row support review, CPU math/axis checks and design. No actual optimizer steps, training runner, remote sync or GPU launch. Future fit needs explicit separate implementation authorization and final contract freeze; no coefficient/budget expansion on failure.
